## Coverage limits and use

The inspected material establishes an introductory frequentist foundation.
It is not evidence that the book supplies complete procedures for modern
online A/B infrastructure, sample-ratio mismatch, sequential stopping,
multiple-testing corrections, complex survey/cluster adjustments, time-series
models, Bayesian inference, equivalence testing, or design-specific power.
Source and validate those methods separately when needed; do not silently
attribute them to this textbook.

For a new analysis, identify the applicable section, check the actual
assumptions and formula, and record the method/software used. PDF text
extraction can omit equations and split words; consult the rendered source
before transcribing a formula. If the cited copy or a required additional
method is unavailable, disclose that gap rather than inventing a citation or
claiming that a general formula was verified against the source.
